verdict.rationale: SumUp's first-party docs list Reader SDKs as one of three in-person integration paths. They say the SDKs let you "embed payment acceptance directly in your Android or iOS app," with the app controlling a reader over Bluetooth or using Tap to Pay. The SDK docs also cover offline store-and-forward transactions. Missing for 10: SDK-level depth such as installation steps, code samples, supported OS versions and API reference for the iOS/Android SDKs; independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile SDKs.
